## AI
Title: [A folk musician became a target for AI fakes and a copyright troll](https://www.theverge.com/entertainment/907111/murphy-campbell-folk-music-ai-copyright)
Key takeaways:
- Folk artist Murphy Campbell discovered AI-generated songs using her vocals uploaded to Spotify, struggling to remove them.
- She later faced invalid YouTube copyright claims on her public domain songs, filed through distributor Vydia.
- Campbell highlights deep-rooted issues in generative AI, music distribution, and copyright, remaining skeptical of platform promises.
